note: Provenance of the local pose model files. The .task binaries are NEVER committed: they live in GOLFME_EVAL_MODEL_DIR (default ~/.cache/golfme-caddie-eval/models). fetch-models.mjs downloads them and refuses a file whose sha256 differs from this manifest; pose-local.mjs re-checks the hash before every run.

modelCard.title: MediaPipe BlazePose GHUM 3D model card
modelCard.licence: Apache License, Version 2.0 (stated under 'LICENSED UNDER' on page 2 of the card, read 2026-10-20). The card covers the Lite, Full and Heavy pose landmark models; the .task bundle also contains the pose detector, which this card does not separately name.
outOfScopePerCard: people further than about 4 m (14 ft) from the camera
modelCard.reportedAccuracy: PDJ (PCK@0.2 of torso diameter) on the vendor's own smartphone fitness/AR photo set: Lite 87.0, Full 91.8, Heavy 94.2 average across 14 regions. Not golf; not our clips.
